mapper.select: SELECT t.team_cd, t.team_nm, t.rgn_nm, m.mtn_tm_nm AS meetingTime, ta.team_age_name AS teamAge, l.tier AS level, t.is_temp, t.view_cnt, t.favorite_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(team_cd) FROM team_user tu WHERE tu.team_cd = t.team_cd) AS userCount, s.stadium_nm AS stadium FROM team t LEFT JOIN meeting_times m ON t.mtn_tm = m.mtn_tm_cd LEFT JOIN team_age ta ON t.team_age = ta.team_age_cd LEFT JOIN levels l ON t.level_cd = l.level_cd LEFT JOIN stadium s ON t.stadium = s.stadium_no;

SELECT t.team_cd, t.team_nm, t.rgn_nm, m.mtn_tm_nm AS meetingTime, ta.team_age_name AS teamAge, l.tier AS level, t.is_temp, t.view_cnt, t.favorite_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(team_cd) FROM team_user tu WHERE tu.team_cd = t.team_cd) AS userCount, s.stadium_nm AS stadium FROM team t LEFT JOIN meeting_times m ON t.mtn_tm = m.mtn_tm_cd LEFT JOIN team_age ta ON t.team_age = ta.team_age_cd LEFT JOIN levels l ON t.level_cd = l.level_cd LEFT JOIN stadium s ON t.stadium = s.stadium_no WHERE t.team_nm like '%${inputParam}%';
